description: This file defines a Java interface 'SQLCommandCondition' with a single method 'checkCondition', used to evaluate conditions related to SQL commands within the Fineract project security utilities.

classes.name: SQLCommandCondition
classes.description: An interface for defining a condition checker that evaluates SQL commands based on certain criteria.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Method to check if a specific SQL command satisfies certain conditions based on the given SQL string and command.
